events.title: Ministry
events.description: Licensed 1735; withdrew c.1748 for intemperance; restored and ordained at Moriches 6 Nov 1755; dismissed 1763; led emigrants to Blooming Grove, Orange Co.; pastor at Brattleboro c.1767/70-1794. [R4-S1]

bio: Dexter ([R4-S1]) makes him a son of Thomas and Bethia (Horton) Reeve of Southold. His candid biography includes two removals for drink, a recovery through Rev. William Throop, and a late, sober pastorate at Brattleboro, where Hayes ([R4-S2]) says he was remembered as 'a fine-looking man, well built, large and portly'. In 1763 he led 'a company of emigrants' from Moriches to Blooming Grove, Orange County, the same move that may have carried John's Tuthill and Smith ancestors to the Clove (Round 2). His stepmother was Mary Wells, granddaughter of William Wells.
sources: [R4-S1] F. B. Dexter, Biographical Sketches of the Graduates of Yale College, vol. 1 (1885) (archive.org full text), pp. 434-435 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/biogsketchgrad01dextuoft

[R4-S2] Charles W. Hayes, William Wells of Southold and his Descendants (1878) (archive.org full text), c. pp. 94-95 (note to ch. VII) (secondary) https://archive.org/details/williamwellsofso00byuhaye
